name: Node.js service review baseline
description: Asynchronous errors, lifecycle, package boundaries, and testing guidance for Node.js services.

rules.title: Asynchronous failures are handled deliberately
rules.rationale: Unhandled promise and event-emitter failures can terminate or corrupt service work.
check_statements: Promises are awaited, returned, or intentionally detached with handling.
Event-emitter error behaviour is accounted for.

rules.title: Lifecycle and failure behaviour is tested
rules.rationale: Service reliability depends on cleanup and error paths as well as successful requests.
check_statements: Changed asynchronous failure paths are tested.
Owned resources are closed during shutdown and tests.
